name: Oskemo Island no Himitsu
original_name: オスケモアイランドの秘密
source:
This is a Visual Novel game where the protagonist has
flirty-dirty with male furries on this Osukemo Island.

This is a sequel story to a novel: [url=https://www.pixiv.net/novel/show.php?id=8736738]Pixiv: Link to Novel[/url]
(The story of this product includes the synopsis of the novel so that
you do not have to read the novel to understand the whole story.)

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ210651.html/?unique_op=af]DLsite[/url]]
